d:
Brazil ke neta luiz inasiyo lula da silva ne shandar vapsi karte hue rashtrapti chunav men jit hasil ki hai. is jit ke sath varkars parti ke 80 varshiy lidar lula ko chauthi bar rashtrapti banne ka mauqa mila hai.
Magar kya hai lula da silva ki kahani aur kaisa bita tha silva ka bachpan?
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
